medfrontal.name: Medial & orbitofrontal cortex
medfrontal.fn: Motivation, social conduct, empathy, eating behaviour

perirolandic.name: Motor & sensory strip (perirolandic)
perirolandic.fn: Limb movement, praxis, cortical sensation; upper motor neurons

parietal.name: Parietal lobe
parietal.fn: Visuospatial skills, praxis, calculation, dressing, navigation

precuneus.name: Precuneus / posterior cingulate
precuneus.fn: Memory retrieval, visual imagery — affected early in Alzheimer disease

anttemp.name: Anterior temporal pole
anttemp.fn: Meaning of words and objects, recognizing people, social-emotional knowledge

perisylvian.name: Language network (left perisylvian)
perisylvian.fn: Fluency and grammar (Broca), comprehension and repetition (Wernicke)

occipital.name: Occipital / visual cortex
occipital.fn: Vision and visual perception; involvement → visual hallucinations, misperception

mamillary.name: Mamillary bodies (Papez circuit)
mamillary.fn: Memory consolidation — damaged by thiamine deficiency

thalamus.name: Thalamus
thalamus.fn: Relay hub: attention, alertness, memory (anterior/medial nuclei)

ventricles.name: Lateral ventricles (CSF)
ventricles.fn: Enlargement stretches nearby fibres → gait, bladder, slowed thinking

whitematter.name: Periventricular white matter
whitematter.fn: Connections for processing speed, gait and bladder control

pons.name: Pons & brainstem nuclei
pons.fn: REM-sleep atonia, autonomic control (BP, bladder), swallowing/speech (bulbar)
